title: Finally found the best
body: So many habit apps, but Grit is the only one that does everything I want: clear progress bars, great support for complex units (like doing something for 15 minutes 8 times a week), great stats, a Mac app, health integration. Love it ❤️

title: Best habit tracker
body: Fantastic app. You can use groups to organise your habits, it has a wide range of specific icons, it’s very complete while not bloated with unnecessary features, great UI, etc. Please keep it this way!

author: Raman_22

title: One of the best trackers, with room for improvement
body:
I love this app; it's well-designed and works well most of the time on all my Apple devices. But I have a wish list for features I would like to see in the near future:

- Apple Health support for more kinds of activities, like yoga.
- Set a goal on just 'Running Distance' instead of 'Walking   Running Distance.'
- Run the Mac app in 'menu-bar mode' without a dock icon.
- More than 3 icons in the large Apple Watch complication, like competitor Streaks.
- Support for Apple Shortcuts.

Keep up the good work!
author: Fevida

title: Convenient app for any purpose
body:
The app is perfect for those who want to track their habits. There is even progress tracking for bad habits.
Works smoothly with Apple Health.
